ValidationRule.description: This validation rule checks if the delegated user is OOO and gives an error.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'Digital Hub')), NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PMC_SS_DelegateUser__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(PMC_SS_DelegateUser__r.PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeEndDate__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(PMC_SS_DelegateUser__r.PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c)), OR( ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_DelegateUser__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeEndDate__c) ), NOT(ISBLANK(PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeEndDate__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c)), OR( AND( PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c >= PMC_SS_DelegateUser__r.PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c, PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeEndDate__c <= PMC_SS_DelegateUser__r.PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeEndDate__c ) ), NOT(ISNEW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The user you selected is already Out Of Office. Please select another user to delegate.
